name: P-319 SIGNUP-ONBOARDING oracle counterexample: the live onboarding check goes red on a non-admitted session from the same live run
summary: Counterexample for SIGNUP-ONBOARDING-P319. The onboarding oracle (portal root with no hosted_auth_error, 'Set up your portal' heading, 'Create workspace' action) was applied to the live capture of an identity that had NOT been admitted (step 1 of live run live2: ordinary sign-in without membership). It failed on all three conditions (exit 1). The same oracle passes on the step-2 capture after explicit sign-up (exit 0), so the check distinguishes an onboarded customer from one who never reached onboarding.

assertions.expected: oracle exits 1 on the non-admitted capture
assertions.evidence: exit 1 with: ORACLE_FAIL hosted_auth_error present (https://app.papercusp.com/?hosted_auth_error=membership_required&hosted_auth_recovery=1); ORACLE_FAIL onboarding heading absent; ORACLE_FAIL Create workspace action absent

assertions.expected: oracle exits 0 on the admitted capture
assertions.evidence: live2-2-signup: exit 0, ORACLE_PASS onboarding reached: https://app.papercusp.com/
